title: Update on Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High-Speed Rail Project Given MyHSR Corp's Recent Request for Information Exercise
what_it_is: Update on Kuala Lumpur-Singapore High-Speed Rail Project Given MyHSR Corp's Recent Request for Information Exercise

sections.label: No new Malaysia proposal received
sections.summary: The reply also addresses a question by Mr Louis Chua, and no new proposal has been received from Malaysia.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: My reply will also address a question by Mr Louis Chua on the same topic.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We have not yet received any new proposal from Malaysia.

sections.label: Plans pending Malaysia proposal
sections.summary: Plans depend on receiving and studying the proposal, keeping an open mind for a win-win arrangement, and Singapore is not involved in the RFI exercise.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As to what are the plans, I think we have to receive the proposal and then we can study the proposal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We will keep an open mind on what are the possibilities, to have a win-win arrangement between Singapore and Malaysia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We are not involved in this RFI exercise.
